propositions: Close must run a separate plan-review gate check before completion verification when require_plan_review_for_close is enabled, to prevent closing after plan or pinned upstream changes during execution.
The CLOSE profile must validate signature, reopen status, registry currency, own-material drift, phase compatibility, and pin enforcement while intentionally excluding code freshness checks.

The close_plan_review_gate_check must execute inside the existing transaction lock after structural checks and before STATUS append, rejecting any plan/signature/phase/material/pin change between precheck and lock.

Unsigned, reopened, stale-registry, own-material drift, malformed metadata, and phase incompatibility must block close regardless of pin enforcement setting; pin drift blocks only when enforce_plan_material_pins is true.
Plan-review close enforcement must default to false for backward compatibility, must perform zero LLM/network calls, and must fail closed with unavailable verdict on unexpected exceptions.
Existing exemptions (bugs, session logs, code reviews, identities, idea→closed) and non-empty force-close reasons must bypass the plan-review gate while preserving structural child-closure rules.
